en.topic_title: China state TV does not air first La Liga games since Mbappe furore
en.topic_summary:
Chinese state television did not air on Saturday the first La Liga games since Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappe caused anger with a joke about the country’s former leader Mao Zedong.



Kylian Mbappe during France v Sweden at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Photo: Wikicommons.



It was not immediately clear whether state broadcaster CCTV had scheduled screenings of the matches and then cancelled them, or whether they were not scheduled in the first place.
